about_the_game:
Relive the heroic response to history's most iconic maritime disaster in Titanic Rescue Game. Take command of the legendary RMS Carpathia, dispatched to the frigid waters of the North Atlantic in 1912. Your urgent mission: locate and safely transport as many of the 20 scattered lifeboats and their precious survivors to the bustling safety of New York.

Prepare for a challenging voyage through four distinct levels, each testing your navigation skills and resolve. From dodging treacherous, moving icebergs in the open ocean to meticulously searching for hidden lifeboats, every maneuver counts. As you escort your rescued fleet, new dangers emerge, including additional rescue vessels and even more ice. The journey culminates in a perilous arrival, guiding the Carpathia through a rocky labyrinth to the iconic Statue of Liberty. In this high-stakes mission, a single collision means game over—but every soul saved adds to your score and cements your place in maritime history.
